review_type: Static source and manifest review; no upstream code, installers, dependencies, tests or release binaries executed.
project_intent: Independent browser-only control implementation. Credentials remain browser-managed; no upstream runtime is imported. Public scanner data has a separate credential-free Node transport.

public_market_exception.credentials: omit; no cookie jar, cookie extraction, caller headers, auth file or authenticated fallback
public_market_exception.validation: 26 offline fixture/egress/canary tests; no live public endpoint request tested

limitations: Selected source paths, not every repository file, were reviewed.
Package tarballs and transitive source were not audited; lock flags are metadata only.
No authenticated TradingView behavior, cookie transmission, or runtime egress was measured.
Tool literal counts are source inventory, not promises of active exposure or correctness.
Upstream branches may change; this document applies only to listed commits.
